notes: Partition verified: 20 source ids and 26 target ids each used exactly once across 19 units (s015+s016 fused).
*to whom* is split correctly — אֲשֶׁר takes *whom*, אֶל takes the fronted *to*, and the resumptive suffix s006 goes unrepresented under rule 22 rather than absorbing the relative.

The supplied *the* of *the thirteenth year* stands before *thirteenth*, and rule 29's counting test (read which word the ASV's *the* stands before) supports leaving it with the fused numeral rather than with the counted noun; the competing reading is named in the unit note, as rule 8 requires.
